brief: AI agency pricing that actually works. Why $5k retainers beat $50/hr every time, and how to position your offer to land them.

slots.author: Drew Nolan
slots.headline: Stop Selling Hours. Start Selling Outcomes.
slots.body: Hourly billing caps your income and punishes efficiency. Here is how $5k retainers unlock real agency growth.

slots.author: Drew Nolan
slots.title: The Hourly Trap
slots.body: Charging $50 per hour ties your revenue to your time. You work more to earn more, which breaks leverage.

slots.author: Drew Nolan
slots.title: Retainers Reward Speed
slots.body: A fixed fee lets you profit from efficiency. Deliver faster results and keep the margin without raising rates.

slots.author: Drew Nolan
slots.title: Price The Outcome
slots.body: Clients buy outcomes, not hours. Shift the conversation from time spent to business results and risk reversal.

slots.author: Drew Nolan
slots.title: Package The $5K Offer
slots.body: Bundle strategy, implementation, and advisory into one tier. Clear scope creates confident buyers and faster sales cycles.

slots.author: Drew Nolan
slots.title: Position As Partner
slots.body: Stop presenting a menu of tasks. Present a roadmap that shows exactly how you drive revenue every month.

slots.author: Drew Nolan
slots.title: Close With Confidence
slots.body: When you believe the retainer is a steal, the client believes it too. Confidence is your best sales asset.

slots.author: Drew Nolan
slots.headline: Time To Ditch Hourly?
slots.body: Drop a 🚀 if you are moving to retainers this quarter. Save this post for your next pricing review.
